claim_summaries: For two determinant-weighted bases made from two-column blocks, a two-column Laplace expansion gives a pointwise paired exchange inequality with factor binom(2|T\S|,2), provided all split-block mismatch outputs are retained.

The exchange outputs, exact proposal probabilities, and registers are computable from rational-complex matrix input without a partition coefficient oracle; per proposal cost is O(d^5) arithmetic operations and polynomial bit complexity.

A directed 4-cycle permutation has two supported paired bases in sector k=2; all whole-block exchange mass is zero while a split-block mismatch term carries the full product mass, so projecting away mismatch registers is invalid.
